data.narrative:
Astroscale is a publicly listed space and aerospace company founded by Mitsunobu Okada. The company has raised over $400M to date and currently trades at an $840M valuation. The peer universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Rocket Lab, Planet Labs, and Firefly Aerospace.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given data availability. Using three same-sector, same-stage public comparables—Rocket Lab ($40.0B), Planet Labs ($7.6B), and Firefly Aerospace ($2.9B)—the median valuation is $7.6B, with a range spanning $2.9B to $40.0B. A public-comp anchoring approach using the Space & Aerospace sector P/S median of 27.4x across six tickers cannot be applied, as Astroscale's revenue is not on file.

The triangulated valuation range is $6.4B to $8.7B, centered on $7.6B. This implies significant upside relative to the current $840M market valuation. The primary constraint on precision is the wide dispersion within the peer set—particularly Rocket Lab's outsized $40.0B valuation—and the absence of revenue data to cross-check via multiples. Key uncertainties include which peer set best reflects Astroscale's risk profile and growth trajectory within the fragmented space sector.
